windowPlacement.description: The host's windows maximize, restore and take a placement, and report their placement, at 100, 100 with 800 by 600 when they open.

embedComponent.description: region-component/1: the policy shows the windows it embeds as components (RunicHostedWindowDecision.EmbedComponent).

browser.description: A browser (serve-only) host: its pages run in the user's browser, and no native window shows them.

allowComponentEmbedding.description: region-component/1: the test application allows component embedding (RunicGuestOptions.AllowComponentEmbedding).

componentBuild.description: region-component/1: the test application's content has a component build (_runic_component/).

elevated.description: The guest runs elevated, as the runner plays it.

placement.description: A Window's placement, IRunicWindowPresentation.Placement: the bounds it restores to (x and y null or absent where there is no position) and whether it is maximized or full-screen.

origin.description: The request's Origin: "embedder" (the default) for the latest region-attach's, or an origin.
